title: A day in the snow
instructions: Arda karlı bir günü anlatıyor. Ne yaptıklarına ve ne olduğuna dikkat et.

script.speaker: arda
script.text: Last January, it snowed for three days in my city.

script.speaker: arda
script.text: The schools were closed, so my sister and I went to the park.

script.speaker: arda
script.text: We built a big snowman and gave him my dad's old hat.

script.speaker: arda
script.text: Then we had a snowball fight with our friends.

script.speaker: arda
script.text: I fell over and hurt my arm, but it wasn't serious.

script.speaker: arda
script.text: When we got home, Mum made us hot soup.
